confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Portuguese prices, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; accommodation is less certain because July rates vary by property, week, and event. FX is from search snippets of the RBA overview and exchange-rate pages (0.6947 listed for 16 Oct 2026, 0.6955 for 15 Oct), not from a page I opened, so verify it on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Portugal's national price level and mid-sized university cities such as Aveiro, Braga, and Leiria, priced below Lisbon and Porto. Cocktail and wine anchors use the usual local relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge of Coimbra bar prices is weak.
